title: Patch: every counter on a hero's portrait can be read: Tipsy, Burn, Luck and Toxic stop hiding under the health, Armor and Credits badges
thread:
**Issue #4251 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #4251: Patch: every counter on a hero's portrait can be read: Tipsy, Burn, Luck and Toxic stop hiding under the health, Armor and Credits badges Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means The small round portrait of each player's hero carries up to eight numbers: health, Armor, Luck, the Jade Counter, Burn, Toxic, Tipsy and Credits. Several of them are drawn on the same spot, so one hides another: - The Tipsy count from the Stinkyscape+ cards is always covered by the health number, so no player can ever read how Tipsy they or their opponent are. - A hero's Burn hides under its Armor. - Luck covers the Credits in a Marketplace game. On a phone there is also no way to tell which green pill is Jade and which is Toxic, because their names only show when a mouse hovers over them. Once this is built, every counter a hero carries shows with its number at the same time, on a phone, a tablet and a desktop. Holding the hero to inspect it lists each counter by name. ## Why - **The badges share a small oval.** The portrait is a 44px oval (`apps/web/src/emotes/emotes.css`, `.hero-portrait`). Every badge on it is a 22px absolutely positioned pill. Health, Armor and Luck have `z-index: 2` (`emotes.css`); Jade, Burn, Toxic, Tipsy and Credits have none (`apps/web/src/game/board.css`, the `.hero-portrait .hero-jade` to `.hero-credits` rules). - **Tipsy is always covered.** Health is always drawn (`apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx`), at the lower right: bottom -4px, 22px tall, 26px on a phone, 32px from 761 by 501 up. Tipsy sits at `right: -6px; top: 22px`, so at least 18 of its 22px lie under the health badge. Its stein and count are covered whenever they show. R3548000 says Tipsy is shown as a stein beside the player's hero on both seats' views. - **Burn, Luck and Toxic collide too.** - Burn sits at `left: -6px; top: 22px`, Armor's lower-left spot, so it is hidden whenever the hero has Armor. - Luck (`right: -6px; bottom: 22px`) covers the Credits (`right: -6px; top: -6px`) by 16px. - Toxic (`left: 18px; top: -6px`) runs about 12px under the Credits in Marketplace games. - **A touch player can't learn the names.** Jade, Burn, Toxic, Tipsy and Credits are named only by `title=` (`apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx`), which a touch screen never shows. The hold-to-inspect view lists only health and Armor (`apps/web/src/emotes/HeroInspect.tsx`). - **Nothing measures it.** - `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx` only checks that the badge exists. - `e2e/cypress/component/emotes-layout.cy.tsx` measures the emote menus and the inspect view, not the badges. ## Proposal - **Give each counter a place no other counter takes.** - Recommended: keep health, Armor, Jade and Credits on the oval's four corners, as #2877 placed them. Draw Luck, Burn, Toxic and Tipsy as small labelled chips of their own beside the plate, for example in the hero's tray (`apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx`), which already sits above or below the plate without moving it. - In the tray they must not count against its allowance (`HERO_TRAY_PHONE_COUNT` is 2), so a counter never falls into the overflow list. - A builder who finds a better arrangement may take it, as long as the criteria below hold. - **The hold-to-inspect view lists every counter above 0** with its name and number. - **Keep each badge's class, `data-*` attribute and testid** (`hero-luck`, `market-credits-`), which other tests and specs read. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx`, `apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx`, `apps/web/src/emotes/HeroInspect.tsx` - `apps/web/src/game/board.css`, `apps/web/src/emotes/emotes.css` - `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx` or a new hero-counters test, and `e2e/cypress/component/emotes-layout.cy.tsx` - The board's section of `apps/web/README.md` - What each counter is: SPEC section 10.1 and R961, R987, R1840005, R3540000 and R3548000. No rule changes. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] A component spec mounts both heroes with every counter above 0 (health, Armor, Luck, Jade, Burn, Toxic, Tipsy, Credits) plus a few modifiers, at each viewport the emotes layout spec uses. It asserts that no two counter badges' boxes overlap, that each lies on the screen, and that the element at the centre of each is that badge or its child. It fails on `main` today. - [ ] A jsdom test that runs on every pull request holds the rule in whatever form the fix takes. For example: each counter above 0 is drawn exactly once, outside the tray's overflow list, with its name as visible text or an accessible name. - [ ] Holding a hero, or Shift+F10 on it, shows every counter above 0 with its name and number. A test renders it with all of them. - [ ] A counter rising from 0 does not move the hero's plate, the reason #2877 put them on the portrait. - [ ] `pnpm -C apps/web test src/game/tipsy.test.tsx` and the hero's other tests pass, with the existing testids kept. ## Size and risks - **Size:** medium. About eight client files of markup and CSS, one component spec and one jsdom test. No engine or server change. - **Risk: the tight phone plate.** The phone's plate is tight: four more chips must fit beside the hero without covering the hand or the opponent's row, which the component spec at the phone viewport checks. - **Risk: only the jsdom test runs per pull request.** Component specs run in the daily run, so the jsdom test is what guards each pull request. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Area: `client` (`suggestions.areas`). Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44454667131)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ # Plan ## Goal Every counter on a hero's portrait reads at the same time on phone, tablet and desktop: health, Armor, Jade and Credits stay on the oval's four corners, while Luck, Burn, Toxic and Tipsy move to labelled chips in the hero's tray beside the plate. Holding a hero (or Shift+F10 on it) lists every counter above 0 by name and number, the plate never moves when a counter rises, and every badge keeps its class, `data-*` attribute and testid. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes there | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx` | change | Render Luck/Burn/Toxic/Tipsy chips from `seat` in a `hero-counters-` span outside the overflow allowance | | `apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx` | change | Remove Burn/Toxic/Tipsy spans and `luck` prop from `HeroPortrait`; pass all counters to `HeroInspect` | | `apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx` | change | Remove `luck` prop and Luck badge; health/Armor only | | `apps/web/src/emotes/HeroInspect.tsx` | change | New optional props plus `HERO_INSPECT_*` testids; stats list renders every counter above 0 | | `apps/web/src/game/board.css` | change | Portrait keeps Jade/Credits corners only; new `.hero-tray .hero-counters` chip row | | `apps/web/src/emotes/emotes.css` | change | Remove `.hero-luck` anchoring; health/Armor rule unchanged | | `apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx` | new | Per-PR jsdom rule test: each counter drawn once, named, outside overflow; inspect lists all; plate unmoved | | `apps/web/src/game/Hero.test.tsx` | change | Luck and Burn/Toxic expectations move to the tray chips | | `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx` | change | R3548000 stein expectation moves to the tray chip | | `e2e/cypress/component/emotes-layout.cy.tsx` | change | New counter-overlap component spec at the existing `VIEWPORTS` | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | Board section: the four portrait corners plus the four tray chips | Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, the engine, cards, AI, server or edge crates, migrations, or wire output. Governing spec: §10.1 (state model), §10.8 (views), §10.10 (client rendering), R961 (Jade), R987 (Luck), R1840005 (Credits), R3540000 (Burn/Toxic), R3548000 (Tipsy). No rule changes and no new ruling note. ## Steps 1. `apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx`: after the `secretBadgeText` import, add a `CounterChip` helper rendering `` containing `{Name} {n}` plus the stein `Icon` for Tipsy. In `HeroTray`, build `counters` from `seat.luck`, `seat.hero.burn`, `seat.hero.toxic`, `seat.tipsy` (each `> 0`), keeping classes `hero-luck`/`hero-burn`/`hero-toxic`/`hero-tipsy`, attrs `data-luck`/`data-burn`/`data-toxic`/`data-tipsy`, and testid `hero-luck` for Luck. Render `` beside the modifiers span, before the `+N` button. Do not add counters to `entries`/`total`/`visible`/`hidden` or `data-count`, so `HERO_TRAY_PHONE_COUNT` (2) never folds one into the overflow list. 2. `apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx`: delete the Burn, Toxic and Tipsy portrait spans (keep Jade and Credits spans untouched); change `` to drop `luck={seat.luck}`. Extend the `` call with `luck={seat.luck} jade={seat.jade} burn={hero.burn} toxic={hero.toxic} tipsy={seat.tipsy} marketCredits={seat.marketCredits}`. 3. `apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx`: remove the `luck?: number` prop and its doc line, and delete the `{luck … hero-luck …}` badge block. Update the header comment to say the portrait badges health lower-right and Armor lower-left only. `Hero.tsx` is the sole caller. 4. `apps/web/src/emotes/HeroInspect.tsx`: add exported constants `HERO_INSPECT_LUCK/JADE/BURN/TOXIC/TIPSY/CREDITS`; extend `HeroInspectProps` with optional `luck, jade, burn, toxic, tipsy, marketCredits: number | undefined`; destructure them and append rows to `dl.hero-inspect-stats` for each `> 0` (Credits when `!== undefined`, even 0, matching the badge), each `
` with `
` name and `
` number. 5. `apps/web/src/game/board.css`: narrow the `.hero-portrait .hero-jade, …` absolute block to Jade and Credits only; delete the `.hero-portrait .hero-burn`, `.hero-toxic`, `.hero-tipsy` rules. Add `.hero-tray .hero-counters { display: inline-flex; gap: var(--space-2); }` and `.hero-tray .hero-counter { flex: none; }` reusing the `.hero-*` pill colors already defined. Tray stays `position: absolute` out of flow, so the `.hero` fixed `--hero-w` plate never moves. 6. `apps/web/src/emotes/emotes.css`: remove `.hero-luck` from the `.hero-health/.hero-armor/.hero-luck` absolute rule and delete the `.hero-portrait .hero-luck` block. Health and Armor anchors unchanged. 7. `apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx` (new, copy `Hero.test.tsx` imports plus `renderBoard`): view with health 30, armor 5, `jade: 3`, `luck: 2`, `hero: {burn: 6, toxic: 2}`, `tipsy: 4`, `marketCredits: 7` and two modifiers. Assert each counter selector appears exactly once in `document` (`.hero-jade`, `[data-testid="hero-luck"]`, `.hero-burn`, `.hero-toxic`, `.hero-tipsy`, `[data-testid="market-credits-you"]`), each outside `[data-testid^="tray-list-"]`, each with its visible name ("Luck", "Burn", "Toxic", "Tipsy", "Jade Counter", "Credits") or accessible name. Assert `tray-more` counts modifiers only. Assert an opened `HeroInspect` shows all six names with numbers. Assert via `readSheet("src/game/board.css")` that `.hero-tray` is `position: absolute` and `.hero` keeps `--hero-w`. 8. Update `apps/web/src/game/Hero.test.tsx` R987 test to expect the Luck chip in `[data-testid="hero-counters-you"]` with text `Luck 1`, kept `data-luck="1"` and `data-testid="hero-luck"`; update R3540005 test to find `.hero-burn`/`.hero-toxic` in the tray span with kept titles. Update `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx` R3548000 test to find `.hero-tipsy[data-tipsy]` in the tray span with kept `title="Tipsy counter"` and the `img.cf-icon` stein. 9. `e2e/cypress/component/emotes-layout.cy.tsx`: add a `describe` over the existing `VIEWPORTS` mounting `Game` with a `fullBoardView()` whose both seats carry all counters above 0 plus three modifiers. For each side, for each of the eight counter selectors, assert `getBoundingClientRect` pairwise non-intersection, on-screen via the file's `expectOnScreen`, and `elementFromPoint` at the box center resolves to the badge or its child (copy `expectDrawnOnTop`'s center-point branch). It fails on `main` where Tipsy/Burn/Luck/Credits overlap. 10. `apps/web/README.md`: extend the Credits paragraph to name the four portrait corners (health, Armor, Jade, Credits) and the four tray chips (Luck, Burn, Toxic, Tipsy with visible names, excluded from the tray allowance), plus the inspect view listing every counter above 0. ## Tests - `apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx`: new `hero counters` suite (once drawn, named, outside overflow; inspect lists all; tray stays absolute). Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx`. - `apps/web/src/game/Hero.test.tsx`: updated R987 and R3540005 tests. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Hero.test.tsx`. - `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx`: updated R3548000 stein test. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/tipsy.test.tsx`. - `e2e/cypress/component/emotes-layout.cy.tsx`: new counter-overlap spec at all `VIEWPORTS`. Run `pnpm --dir e2e test:component` for that file (daily run; not per-PR). - Typecheck and lint the touched web files: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx apps/web/src/emotes/HeroInspect.tsx apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx`. No `cargo jackioh spec check` needed: no ruling note added or cited text changed. ## Done when - [ ] Both heroes with all counters above 0 show all eight at once with no box overlap, on phone, tablet and desktop viewports. - [ ] Per-PR jsdom test holds the rule in its new form (each counter once, named, outside overflow). - [ ] Hold / Shift+F10 inspect lists every counter above 0 with name and number. - [ ] A counter rising from 0 does not move the plate. - [ ] Existing testids kept; touched web tests, typecheck and eslint pass. ## Risks - Tight phone plate: four tray chips could cover the hand or opponent row. Mitigation: chips ride the existing out-of-flow tray toward the field (above yours, below the opponent's) with `max-width` ellipsis like modifier chips; the component spec measures the phone viewport. - Only jsdom runs per PR: layout regressions slip to daily. Mitigation: the jsdom test pins structure and names, plus `readSheet` CSS guards on the tray's absolute position and the plate's fixed width. - Label change breaks badge-text readers: Luck/Burn/Toxic/Tipsy text becomes `Name N` instead of `N`. Mitigation: classes, `data-*` attrs and testids unchanged; only `Hero.test.tsx`/`tipsy.test.tsx` expectations move, which this plan names. ## Open questions None. The arrangement follows the issue's recommended option; a builder taking a different overlap-free layout keeps the same testids, names and criteria. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-11-19T03:49:53Z: approve ```

Holding a hero (or Shift+F10 on it) lists every counter above 0 by name and number, the plate never moves when a counter rises, and every badge keeps its class, `data-*` attribute and testid. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes there | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx` | change | Render Luck/Burn/Toxic/Tipsy chips from `seat` in a `hero-counters-` span outside the overflow allowance | | `apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx` | change | Remove Burn/Toxic/Tipsy spans and `luck` prop from `HeroPortrait`; pass all counters to `HeroInspect` | | `apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx` | change | Remove `luck` prop and Luck badge; health/Armor only | | `apps/web/src/emotes/HeroInspect.tsx` | change | New optional props plus `HERO_INSPECT_*` testids; stats list renders every counter above 0 | | `apps/web/src/game/board.css` | change | Portrait keeps Jade/Credits corners only; new `.hero-tray .hero-counters` chip row | | `apps/web/src/emotes/emotes.css` | change | Remove `.hero-luck` anchoring; health/Armor rule unchanged | | `apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx` | new | Per-PR jsdom rule test: each counter drawn once, named, outside overflow; inspect lists all; plate unmoved | | `apps/web/src/game/Hero.test.tsx` | change | Luck and Burn/Toxic expectations move to the tray chips | | `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx` | change | R3548000 stein expectation moves to the tray chip | | `e2e/cypress/component/emotes-layout.cy.tsx` | change | New counter-overlap component spec at the existing `VIEWPORTS` | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | Board section: the four portrait corners plus the four tray chips | Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, the engine, cards, AI, server or edge crates, migrations, or wire output. Governing spec: §10.1 (state model), §10.8 (views), §10.10 (client rendering), R961 (Jade), R987 (Luck), R1840005 (Credits), R3540000 (Burn/Toxic), R3548000 (Tipsy). No rule changes and no new ruling note. ## Steps 1. `apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx`: after the `secretBadgeText` import, add a `CounterChip` helper rendering `` containing `{Name} {n}` plus the stein `Icon` for Tipsy. In `HeroTray`, build `counters` from `seat.luck`, `seat.hero.burn`, `seat.hero.toxic`, `seat.tipsy` (each `> 0`), keeping classes `hero-luck`/`hero-burn`/`hero-toxic`/`hero-tipsy`, attrs `data-luck`/`data-burn`/`data-toxic`/`data-tipsy`, and testid `hero-luck` for Luck. Render `` beside the modifiers span, before the `+N` button. Do not add counters to `entries`/`total`/`visible`/`hidden` or `data-count`, so `HERO_TRAY_PHONE_COUNT` (2) never folds one into the overflow list. 2. `apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx`: delete the Burn, Toxic and Tipsy portrait spans (keep Jade and Credits spans untouched); change `` to drop `luck={seat.luck}`. Extend the `` call with `luck={seat.luck} jade={seat.jade} burn={hero.burn} toxic={hero.toxic} tipsy={seat.tipsy} marketCredits={seat.marketCredits}`. 3. `apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx`: remove the `luck?: number` prop and its doc line, and delete the `{luck … hero-luck …}` badge block. Update the header comment to say the portrait badges health lower-right and Armor lower-left only. `Hero.tsx` is the sole caller. 4. `apps/web/src/emotes/HeroInspect.tsx`: add exported constants `HERO_INSPECT_LUCK/JADE/BURN/TOXIC/TIPSY/CREDITS`; extend `HeroInspectProps` with optional `luck, jade, burn, toxic, tipsy, marketCredits: number | undefined`; destructure them and append rows to `dl.hero-inspect-stats` for each `> 0` (Credits when `!== undefined`, even 0, matching the badge), each `
` with `
` name and `
` number. 5. `apps/web/src/game/board.css`: narrow the `.hero-portrait .hero-jade, …` absolute block to Jade and Credits only; delete the `.hero-portrait .hero-burn`, `.hero-toxic`, `.hero-tipsy` rules. Add `.hero-tray .hero-counters { display: inline-flex; gap: var(--space-2); }` and `.hero-tray .hero-counter { flex: none; }` reusing the `.hero-*` pill colors already defined. Tray stays `position: absolute` out of flow, so the `.hero` fixed `--hero-w` plate never moves. 6. `apps/web/src/emotes/emotes.css`: remove `.hero-luck` from the `.hero-health/.hero-armor/.hero-luck` absolute rule and delete the `.hero-portrait .hero-luck` block. Health and Armor anchors unchanged. 7. `apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx` (new, copy `Hero.test.tsx` imports plus `renderBoard`): view with health 30, armor 5, `jade: 3`, `luck: 2`, `hero: {burn: 6, toxic: 2}`, `tipsy: 4`, `marketCredits: 7` and two modifiers. Assert each counter selector appears exactly once in `document` (`.hero-jade`, `[data-testid="hero-luck"]`, `.hero-burn`, `.hero-toxic`, `.hero-tipsy`, `[data-testid="market-credits-you"]`), each outside `[data-testid^="tray-list-"]`, each with its visible name ("Luck", "Burn", "Toxic", "Tipsy", "Jade Counter", "Credits") or accessible name. Assert `tray-more` counts modifiers only. Assert an opened `HeroInspect` shows all six names with numbers. Assert via `readSheet("src/game/board.css")` that `.hero-tray` is `position: absolute` and `.hero` keeps `--hero-w`. 8. Update `apps/web/src/game/Hero.test.tsx` R987 test to expect the Luck chip in `[data-testid="hero-counters-you"]` with text `Luck 1`, kept `data-luck="1"` and `data-testid="hero-luck"`; update R3540005 test to find `.hero-burn`/`.hero-toxic` in the tray span with kept titles. Update `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx` R3548000 test to find `.hero-tipsy[data-tipsy]` in the tray span with kept `title="Tipsy counter"` and the `img.cf-icon` stein. 9. `e2e/cypress/component/emotes-layout.cy.tsx`: add a `describe` over the existing `VIEWPORTS` mounting `Game` with a `fullBoardView()` whose both seats carry all counters above 0 plus three modifiers. For each side, for each of the eight counter selectors, assert `getBoundingClientRect` pairwise non-intersection, on-screen via the file's `expectOnScreen`, and `elementFromPoint` at the box center resolves to the badge or its child (copy `expectDrawnOnTop`'s center-point branch). It fails on `main` where Tipsy/Burn/Luck/Credits overlap. 10. `apps/web/README.md`: extend the Credits paragraph to name the four portrait corners (health, Armor, Jade, Credits) and the four tray chips (Luck, Burn, Toxic, Tipsy with visible names, excluded from the tray allowance), plus the inspect view listing every counter above 0. ## Tests - `apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx`: new `hero counters` suite (once drawn, named, outside overflow; inspect lists all; tray stays absolute). Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx`. - `apps/web/src/game/Hero.test.tsx`: updated R987 and R3540005 tests. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Hero.test.tsx`. - `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx`: updated R3548000 stein test. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/tipsy.test.tsx`. - `e2e/cypress/component/emotes-layout.cy.tsx`: new counter-overlap spec at all `VIEWPORTS`. Run `pnpm --dir e2e test:component` for that file (daily run; not per-PR). - Typecheck and lint the touched web files: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx apps/web/src/emotes/HeroInspect.tsx apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx`. No `cargo jackioh spec check` needed: no ruling note added or cited text changed. ## Done when - [ ] Both heroes with all counters above 0 show all eight at once with no box overlap, on phone, tablet and desktop viewports. - [ ] Per-PR jsdom test holds the rule in its new form (each counter once, named, outside overflow). - [ ] Hold / Shift+F10 inspect lists every counter above 0 with name and number. - [ ] A counter rising from 0 does not move the plate. - [ ] Existing testids kept; touched web tests, typecheck and eslint pass. ## Risks - Tight phone plate: four tray chips could cover the hand or opponent row. Mitigation: chips ride the existing out-of-flow tray toward the field (above yours, below the opponent's) with `max-width` ellipsis like modifier chips; the component spec measures the phone viewport. - Only jsdom runs per PR: layout regressions slip to daily. Mitigation: the jsdom test pins structure and names, plus `readSheet` CSS guards on the tray's absolute position and the plate's fixed width. - Label change breaks badge-text readers: Luck/Burn/Toxic/Tipsy text becomes `Name N` instead of `N`. Mitigation: classes, `data-*` attrs and testids unchanged; only `Hero.test.tsx`/`tipsy.test.tsx` expectations move, which this plan names. ## Open questions None. The arrangement follows the issue's recommended option; a builder taking a different overlap-free layout keeps the same testids, names and criteria.
